title: The Erciyes Fragments
summary: A Cainite prophecy of the Thirteen.

claims.text: The Erciyes Fragments are a prophecy, with later scholars’ notes in the margins, foretelling that the Thirteen will die a death with no bloodshed and leave no ghosts, which its readers take to mean diablerie.
Its annotators note the rumour that Brujah was slain by Brujah’s own childe, a tale one of them dismisses as Ventrue slander.
One verse speaks of a second founder bound and claimed by magic, which an annotator reads as a jab at the Tremere usurpers.
